name: programme-unit
description: A single programme unit together with what it produced and what it needs: the findings harvested from it, the carried context the next unit must read before it starts, and the units it depends on.

aiGuidance.purpose: One unit of programme work, sized to be started and finished in a single pass, recorded with everything a later thread needs to pick it up cold: the decision mode and door that say how to approach it, the findings it produced, and the carried context that must be read before the next unit starts.
aiGuidance.extraction: Author the unit first — title, summary, decision mode, door, issue refs, body — then attach what it produced. Each durable lesson becomes a finding contained by the unit; each thing the next unit must know before it starts becomes carried_context contained by the unit. Where this unit cannot begin until another has landed, record depends-on between the two units rather than restating the dependency in prose. Walk the programme-unit-walk Protocol to fill it: its stages are the order in which the understanding is built, not a checklist to backfill afterwards.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Do not create a unit for an observation or a conclusion — those are findings. Do not leave a lesson in a PR description or an issue comment; if it is durable it is a record. Do not express ordering or dependency by unit title or issue number.
